sequence_alignment.algorithm: Needleman-Wunsch global alignment with forward/reverse optimal-edge analysis
sequence_alignment.stable_pair_policy: A pair is retained only when each residue is paired exclusively to the other and neither residue can be gapped in any optimal alignment.

technical_limits.status: developer review limits, not biological similarity cutoffs

chemical_state_policy: This aligned co-crystal record preserves the deposited ligand graph and charge. It does not replace the platform's separately defined explicitly neutral original default.
limitations: No atom-specific SAR was curated; strict design has zero approved modifiable sites and requires expert review.
UNKNOWN sites remain UNKNOWN and may only be explored under an explicitly exploratory policy.
A co-crystal pose and receptor-frame comparison do not establish affinity, selectivity, or attachment tolerance.
Coordinates are a rigidly transformed deposited ligand pose, not a docking result.
Alignment limits are technical developer-review limits, not biological acceptance criteria.
The fixed 6HAZ receptor enables pose comparison and hypothesis generation only.
The requested two SAR-qualified sites, each with 20 valid graphs, remain unmet unless explicit evidence is curated later.

measured_evidence.join_policy: Stored separately; no cross-assay potency ordering or medchem graph join is performed here.

observed_source_chemical_state.coordinate_provenance: source bound-ligand coordinates after receptor-frame rigid transformation
observed_source_chemical_state.label: deposited source state
observed_source_chemical_state.neutral_parent_handling: Handled separately by the platform; this builder does not claim or emit a neutralized state.

suitability.strict_modifiable_site_explanation: No SAR-qualified modifiable site is supplied; expert curation is required rather than treating this as an error.

unknown_site_policy: No missing or UNKNOWN SAR state is promoted to MODIFIABLE.
